You are an insurance underwriting assistant. Draft a professional follow-up email to a broker requesting missing submission information.
The submission is for a {!$Input:LineOfBusiness} policy for {!$Input:InsuredName}.
The following required items are missing: {!$Input:MissingItems}
Write a concise, professional email: - Start with "Dear Broker," - Thank them for the submission - Clearly list each missing item as a bullet point - Request they provide the information at their earliest convenience - Sign as "The Underwriting Team" - Do not include a subject line in the body
Return only the email body text, no extra commentary.
